official: 練馬区立小学校および中学校の学校医、学校歯科医ならびに学校薬剤師の公務災害補償に関する条例の一部を改正する条例
committee: 文教児童青少年委員会

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案の内容

name: 学校医などの公務災害補償を引き上げ
summary: 区立小・中学校の学校医などへの公務災害補償について、補償額などを引き上げます。介護補償と葬祭補償の額、休業補償等に係る補償基礎額が対象です。施行日は公布の日です。
changes: 介護補償と葬祭補償の額を引き上げる
休業補償等に係る補償基礎額を引き上げる
who: 区立小学校の学校医、学校歯科医、学校薬剤師
区立中学校の学校医、学校歯科医、学校薬剤師
why: 都立学校の条例改正を踏まえ、東京都との均衡を図るためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Raises public-service accident compensation for school doctors and others
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on Compensation for Public-Service Accidents Involving School Physicians, School Dentists, and School Pharmacists at Nerima City Elementary and Junior High Schools
en.summary: The ward will raise compensation amounts and other benefits for school physicians and others at ward-run elementary and junior high schools who suffer public-service accidents. This covers care and funeral compensation amounts, and the basic compensation amount used for compensation for time off work and similar benefits. The ordinance will take effect on the date it is promulgated.
changes: Raises care and funeral compensation amounts
Raises the basic compensation amount used for compensation for time off work and similar benefits
who: School physicians, school dentists, and school pharmacists at ward-run elementary schools
School physicians, school dentists, and school pharmacists at ward-run junior high schools
en.why: The ward says this is to maintain balance with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, following amendments to the ordinance for Tokyo Metropolitan Government schools.
